title: Missing Brute-Force Rate Limiting on Admin Login Endpoint
evidence: POST /api/admin/auth/login directly calls authenticateUser(email, password) without checking IP attempt counters or account lockout thresholds.
fix: Implement sliding-window IP and account rate limiting (5 failed attempts per 15 minutes) before invoking scrypt password verification.
test: Automated script sending 10 consecutive failed login requests receives HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

title: Incomplete Middleware Session Check Bypasses Cryptographic Signature Validation
evidence: src/middleware.ts checks only Boolean(req.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value) without verifying the HMAC signature.
fix: Import verifySessionToken in middleware or validate the HMAC signature before allowing request continuation.
test: Request to /admin/tenants with Cookie: __va_session=invalid.signature is immediately redirected to /admin/login by middleware.

title: Embed Authorization Token Validation Disabled by Default in Environment Schema
evidence: EMBED_AUTH_ENABLED defaults to 'false' in env.ts:22; when false, requireEmbedApiAuth allows all tenant IDs without verifying embed tokens or parent domains.
fix: Require EMBED_AUTH_ENABLED='true' by default in production and validate parent domain origins against tenant allowedDomains.
test: Request to /api/config with a valid tenantId but missing x-embed-token returns HTTP 401 when NODE_ENV=production.

title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Disabled by Default and Not Distributed for Multi-Container Deployment
evidence: TENANT_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED defaults to 'false' in src/lib/config/env.ts:41, and runtime buckets use in-memory Map in src/lib/tenants/runtime-access.ts:62.
fix: Default TENANT_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED to 'true', enforce per-tenant quotas across all speech and chat routes, and integrate Redis or MongoDB-backed rate buckets.
test: Exceeding 60 requests per minute on /api/speak returns HTTP 429 across multi-worker deployments.

title: Unbounded Chat History Input and Missing Role Sanitization in Chat Route
evidence: src/app/api/chat/route.ts:45 accepts body.messages as an arbitrary array and forwards it directly to streamChatReply without length or role filtering.
fix: Enforce a maximum history length (e.g., last 20 messages), validate that roles are strictly 'user' | 'assistant', and limit message content to 2,000 characters.
test: Submitting a message with role 'system' or an array of 50 messages returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.

title: Repetitive Database Index Creation Executed on Every Authentication Lookup
evidence: src/lib/auth/users.ts:37 executes await ensureAuthUserIndexes(db) inside getAuthDb(), called by authenticateUser and getAuthUserById.
fix: Move ensureAuthUserIndexes to application bootstrap or a dedicated once-per-process initialization flag.
test: Executing 100 consecutive authenticateUser calls issues createIndex commands only once.

title: Lack of Hard Spend Limit Caps on Tenant OpenAI and ElevenLabs Consumption
evidence: src/app/api/speak/route.ts and src/app/api/chat/route.ts record usage events but do not evaluate monthly dollar or character spending limits.
fix: Check cumulative monthly usage against tenant tier limits in requireTenantRuntimeAccess before calling external AI providers.
test: Tenant exceeding monthly character limit receives HTTP 402 Payment Required or HTTP 429 quota exhausted.

title: Total Absence of Automated Unit, Integration, and End-to-End Tests
evidence: package.json contains no test script; repository contains 0 test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts).
fix: Install Vitest, configure tests for lib/security/encryption.ts, lib/ai/lead-tokens.ts, and lib/auth/session.ts, and add npm test to CI.
test: npm test runs and passes test suites for crypto, token parsing, and auth session verification.

title: Missing Automated CI/CD Test and Verification Pipeline in Repository
evidence: No .github/workflows directory or CI pipeline configuration files exist in the repository.
fix: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml running npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run build on every pull request and push to master.
test: Opening a pull request with a deliberate TypeScript syntax error triggers a failed CI check.

title: Unbounded Fallback Collection Growth on Tenant Database Connectivity Failures
evidence: src/lib/db/conversation-store.ts:80 falls back silently to platform DB on TLS or network error without scheduled reconciliation or TTL.
fix: Unified all tenant data storage into the platform database with strict cryptographic Row-Level Security (RLS) enforcement, eliminating external fallback connection failures.
test: Triggering a TLS connection failure logs an alert event and flags the record for automated retry migration.

title: Synchronous SMTP Notification in Call Summarization Path Without Queued Retry
evidence: src/app/api/summarize/route.ts:60 awaits sendCallSummaryEmail; if the SMTP socket fails or times out, the email is lost.
fix: Persist unsent lead email notifications to a MongoDB outbox collection with an exponential backoff retry worker.
test: Simulating SMTP connection failure queues the email record in MongoDB outbox for subsequent retry.

title: Voice Widget Transcript Lacks ARIA Live Region for Screen Reader Announcements
evidence: src/components/voice-agent/transcript-panel.tsx:38 defines transcript container without aria-live='polite' or aria-relevant='additions'.
fix: Add aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='false' to the transcript message container.
test: VoiceOver on macOS announces newly streamed assistant speech sentences automatically upon arrival.

title: Customer Personal Data in Voice Transcripts Retained Indefinitely Without Expiration TTL
evidence: src/lib/db/call-records.ts writes conversation documents to MongoDB without a TTL expiry index or retention cleanup schedule.
fix: Add a configurable retentionDays setting per tenant and configure a MongoDB TTL index on createdAt.
test: Documents with createdAt older than retention threshold are purged by MongoDB TTL background process.

title: Missing Short-Lived Caching Layer for Repeated Dynamic Tenant Configurations
evidence: src/app/api/config/route.ts queries MongoDB on every GET request without Cache-Control headers or an in-memory TTL cache.
fix: Introduce a 60-second in-memory LRU or Next.js unstable_cache for tenant agent configurations.
test: Consecutive GET /api/config requests within 60 seconds return cached results without re-querying MongoDB.
